title: Access RMS web application via site Argus server IP and verify the RMS overview screen loads
summary: Verify that the RMS / fleet status web UI is reachable from a supported workstation using the site-provided unique IP, that login succeeds with the provided username/password, and that the RMS overview screen loads. Use this as the first connectivity/login check when troubleshooting RMS web availability.
when_to_use: Use when you need a first-pass check that the RMS web application is reachable and that authentication leads to the RMS overview screen (the initial landing/overview page).
not_for: Do not use this procedure as a deep-dive into specific AGV faults or active error root cause after the overview screen is already reachable.
roles_and_responsibilities: L1_support: Perform the RMS web reachability and login-to-overview verification using the site-provided unique IP and provided credentials.

access_required: Valid RMS username/password for the site
system_preconditions: You have the site-provided unique IP address for the RMS web location

visual_references.description: Training frame showing the RMS web application landing/overview context and the statement that each site has an Argus server and a unique IP to access the RMS web location; includes the overview screen reference.

steps.title: Open the RMS web location using the site-provided unique IP
steps.purpose: Confirm basic network reachability to the RMS web application endpoint for the site.
steps.instruction: From a supported workstation, open a web browser and navigate to the site-provided RMS web location using the unique IP address for the RMS service.
steps.expected_result: The RMS web application landing page loads (i.e., the browser reaches the RMS web location).
steps.healthy_condition: The RMS web application page is reachable and displays the RMS login flow.
steps.failure_condition: The RMS page does not load (blank/unreachable).

actions.label: Navigate to RMS unique IP
actions.exact_action: Open a web browser and navigate to the site-provided RMS web location using the unique IP address for the RMS service.

stop_or_escalate_if: If the RMS web application is unreachable (page won’t load), stop and escalate as an RMS web access/connectivity issue.

source_evidence.quote: “for each site, you're gonna, we're gonna have a Argus server and you're gonna access the RMS web location… you're gonna have a unique IP address to access this RMS service.”

steps.title: Authenticate on the RMS login page
steps.purpose: Confirm that credentials work and that the session can be established.
steps.instruction: On the RMS login page, enter the username and password provided for RMS access, then submit/login.
steps.expected_result: Login succeeds and the session proceeds to the RMS overview screen.
steps.healthy_condition: After submitting credentials, the RMS overview screen is reached.
steps.failure_condition: Login does not succeed or does not proceed to the RMS overview screen.

actions.label: Enter credentials and login
actions.exact_action: Put in the username and password… and you all will have it if you don't know it already.

stop_or_escalate_if: If login does not lead to the RMS overview screen, treat it as an RMS web access/connectivity issue and stop further RMS/API actions until connectivity is restored.

source_evidence.quote: “once you access that address, you put in the username and password… And this is what you will see. This is the overview screen”

steps.title: Verify the RMS overview screen is displayed
steps.purpose: Confirm that the authenticated landing page is the RMS overview screen, indicating the RMS web UI is functioning end-to-end for the operator view.
steps.instruction: After login, verify you are on the RMS overview screen (the screen described as “this is what you will see… the overview screen”).
steps.expected_result: The RMS overview screen is displayed.
steps.healthy_condition: The overview screen loads successfully after login.
steps.failure_condition: The overview screen does not appear after successful login.

actions.label: Confirm overview screen
actions.exact_action: Verify you are on the RMS overview screen.

stop_or_escalate_if: If the overview screen does not appear after successful login, stop further RMS/API actions and escalate as an RMS web access/connectivity issue.

source_evidence.quote: “And this is what you will see. This is the overview screen”

success_criteria: RMS web application is reachable using the site’s unique IP.
Login succeeds using the provided username/password.
The RMS overview screen is displayed after login.
healthy_conditions: RMS web page loads and the login flow completes to the overview screen.
failure_conditions: RMS web application is unreachable (page won’t load).
Login does not lead to the RMS overview screen.
escalation_guidance: Escalate if the RMS web application is unreachable or if login does not lead to the RMS overview screen; treat as an RMS web access/connectivity issue and do not proceed with further RMS/API actions until connectivity is restored.

screens_or_images.what_to_look_at: Use as visual context for the RMS web application/overview screen described in the segment (Argus server + unique IP access + overview screen landing).

image_refs.what_to_look_at: Use as visual context for the RMS web application/overview screen described in the segment (Argus server + unique IP access + overview screen landing).

missing_details: The source does not provide the exact RMS login page URL path, specific button labels, or the exact UI field names for username/password; only the presence of username/password and the overview screen are described.
